name: v21b_seed_low
description: Start the zone LIGHTLY seeded and run to equilibrium (~48 game-days). Owner: don't dump a big bug population in before the food ramps (fruit drop/rot, compost fill, nectar regrow all take game-days) — on a fresh start that mass-starves. ONE lever vs baseline: bug_spawning `initial` counts cut ~4x so populations GROW into the food supply instead of crashing off the line. This is the first faithful (predation-inclusive) tuning pass since predation moved client-side.
